verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an official remote MCP server that lets AI assistants query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call and manage escalations. It also has a documented REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, so escalation is covered through an agent-facing channel. However, no evidence shows that acknowledging alerts/pages or resolving and closing incidents can be done through the API or MCP, so the full lifecycle is unconfirmed. missing for 10: documented acknowledge action via API/MCP, documented incident resolve/status-update endpoints or MCP tools, hands-on corroboration of a full dashboard-free lifecycle.
